_comment: P3-4 Lemonade bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A local model server: pulls models from Hugging Face and runs them on the machine; supports the llama.cpp backend, plus an experimental vLLM ROCm backend on AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ (official FAQ).
axes.runtime: A long-running local service: Windows installer or the full SDK; exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and can work with the Ryzen AI toolchain.
axes.local_files: Models and data stay local; no cloud account dependency, which suits offline and privacy-sensitive use.
axes.background: A long-running service that other apps can call; no official statement of continuing after shutdown.
axes.tools: Primarily an inference service; tool-calling and MCP not verified item by item.
axes.context: Long context depends on model and VRAM/RAM configuration; limits follow the official FAQ.
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; permissions come from the host environment.
axes.fit: Fits AMD Ryzen AI / NPU users who want a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint for offline or private work. Does not fit NVIDIA-only optimisation or an out-of-the-box GUI chat app (see LM Studio and similar).

runs: This site has not completed throughput or VRAM tests; the conclusions cover runtime capability and licensing only.
unknowns:
- NPU/GPU acceleration matrix across Ryzen models
- Tool-calling and MCP support status
- Stability boundaries of the experimental vLLM ROCm backend
related: Intel-side local inference, contrasting with the AMD route.
